_comment: PRD-261 A-06a: the shared corpus. Python (tests/test_prd261_theme_package.py) and TypeScript (frontend/lib/theme-host/__tests__/validator-parity.test.ts, A-06b) each run every case. A case's code is null when the input is valid; otherwise the check returns at least one error and every error carries that code. manifests: base with set (top-level fields replaced) and unset (fields removed), or document (the whole input). looks: base checked against schema the same way. cssValues, prepaint, lookSchemas: the input as given. cssScope and packages are Python-only (the server's CSS scope check and the zip reader); a package case changes the hello package: manifestSet/manifestUnset on its theme.json, replace sets a file's text (null drops it). A-19c: a prepaint case may also carry messages, the exact sentences both languages give, in order (the tone rule's cases). M-01 (host 1.1.0): the cases named mobile hold theme.json's mobile block; in manifests both languages run them, in packages the server's reader (M-02) and the kit's port of it (M-06) do, and a font's bytes are written as text of characters below U+0080 (each one byte in UTF-8, so a test can build an sfnt header). contrast (M-03 measures it; Python and look-kit each run it): every case is a pair of mobile token values (an 'H S% L%' triplet or #rrggbb), foregroundHex and backgroundHex are the #RRGGBB both parse to (services/themes/mobile_tokens.py parse_colour, lib/look-kit/hsl.ts tripletToHex), and ratio is their WCAG 2.x contrast ratio to two decimals (lib/look-kit/contrast.ts contrastRatio).
